_metadata.description: Flow Inventory MVP screen: list discovered flows with last-run status; offer Verify all.

requirements.title: InventoryPage lists all discovered flows
requirements.description: ui/src/features/inventory/InventoryPage.tsx fetches /api/v1/flows + latest /api/v1/runs and renders one row per flow with id, path, language, schema version, last status.

validation.notes: Vitest renders InventoryPage against mocked API; asserts row count and status badges.

requirements.title: Verify all triggers verification per flow
requirements.description: A single Verify all button posts /api/v1/verifications for each flow and updates row status as each finishes.

validation.notes: Vitest user-event test asserts button click triggers POST per row and updates status after resolution.

requirements.title: Accessibility baseline
requirements.description: Inventory page passes axe a11y test with no violations at WCAG-AA.
